question: Who must employ the class-marked forms at the end of the mantras?
premises: Forms joined with a birth-class are specified.
These forms are to be applied at the end.
The ritual actor responsible is the priest.
inference: The priest must employ the class-marked forms at the end of the mantras.
uncertainties: The precise referent of jāti in this ritual context is not fully specified.
plain_english: At the end, the priest should employ the forms joined with the appropriate class markers.
